# UmaLytics 0.5.4

## Fixes and improvements

- **Room detection:** the room code is read only from the lobby's own room-code elements, so text elsewhere on the page can no longer be mistaken for a room. Room changes and reconnects are handled more reliably.
- **Scouting window:** clicking the icon now focuses the open scouting window instead of opening a second one, and the window keeps its size and position after the browser has been idle.
- **Rank:** profiles no longer all show "timed out" when the leaderboard is slow. When a player's rank cannot be loaded, the card shows "Rank unknown" instead of failing.
- **Rate limits:** recovery after a rate limit is gentler and steadier. Requests slow down once per pause and speed up again gradually, and automatic retries run when the cards say they will.
- **Hidden stats:** loaded match history no longer changes the badges of a player whose stats are hidden.
- **Firefox:** Firefox 128 or later is now required.
- **Privacy:** PRIVACY.md is rewritten and lists exactly what is requested and stored.

## Update

Download and extract the ZIP for your browser. Disable the previous extension, load the new build, reopen UmaLytics and refresh your drafter tabs. Confirm **v0.5.4** in the header.

The Chromium ZIP supports Chrome, Edge, Brave and Opera GX. Firefox / LibreWolf (version 128 or later) uses an unsigned temporary add-on, which must be loaded again after a browser restart. SHA256SUMS.txt contains optional download integrity checksums.

Automated regression, type and build checks passed before release; they do not replace live installed-browser testing.
